_comment: Phase-1 insider-tracking universe (contract §4.2: ticker-scoped until Requirement A). Sixty large, widely held or frequently Congress-traded names plus SPY and the sector ETFs the scoreboard benchmarks against. Kept small on purpose: sec_form4 walks ~21 polite requests per ticker on a cold run (1.5 s/host), so 60 tickers is ~30 minutes inside the 60-minute ingest job; steady state is one index fetch per ticker. Tickers the congress_ptr job discovers are added to `securities` automatically and join this universe on the next run. Edit freely; the universe job upserts, never deletes.
